mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month consistently precedes positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns, with no requirement for additional conditions to activate the signal.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a tightening cycle that leads to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS > 5.0% periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
